reviews.review_msg: One of the most frustrating teaching experiences I've had. Concepts are not explained clearly, and the lectures often leave students more confused than when they started. A lot of independent studying is needed just to understand what should have been covered properly in class.

Very disappointing experience with this professor. The lectures are difficult to follow, explanations are often unclear, and students are left to figure out important concepts on their own. The teaching style makes an already challenging course unnecessarily frustrating.

Would not recommend. The lectures were hard to follow and the exams were way too difficult compared to what we were taught. I spent a lot of time studying but still felt completely unprepared for the tests.

Not a good professor. The exams were extremely difficult and felt much harder than what was covered in class. The teaching was unclear and did not prepare students well for the tests. Overall, a very frustrating experience.

It's near impossible to keep up in lecture. It is quite hard to understand him due to the language barrier and he uses ALOT of technical terms. Lots of 'Uhms' and 'uhs' while he talks makes it even harder to keep up. 

You'll have to learn everything on your own.
